title: Evaluating Visual and Cultural Interpretation: The K-Viscuit Benchmark with Human-VLM Collaboration
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures knowledge of Korean cultural concepts related to religion, specifically through visual question answering about historical structures and artifacts (e.g., dolmens).
findings: Proprietary models significantly outperformed open-source models on the 'Religion' category questions. The highest scoring model, GPT-4o, achieved an accuracy of 85.19%, while the best performing open-source model, Llama-3.2-11B, scored 70.37%. This indicates a gap in the ability of models to recognize and reason about culturally specific religious artifacts and concepts from Korea.
